'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Steve S LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve S]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Republic At War / A Precarious Predicament]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
